defects.problem: This is not a crouch. All 4 frames are the guard stance, and the head drops only about 6 px out of about 117 (about 5%). The knees barely bend and the hips stay high, so holding down looks like standing still.
defects.detail: crouches down very low on the spot into a deep squat: both knees bent fully, thighs pressed against the calves, hips dropped right down onto the heels so the head ends at about half his standing height, back bent forward over the knees, fists still raised in guard in front of the chest, facing right, holds the low squat. Only Kakashi is drawn

defects.problem: The dogs come out wrong. In frames 3-4 the two dogs face each other, not the opponent. In frames 5-8 their heads merge into one two-headed brown blob biting itself in the middle. In frames 9-10 a dog runs out and is cut off by the right frame edge. Kakashi also lifts his palm off the ground and kneels upright from frame 3 on, so the slam is never held. The summoned dogs are a big effect that the game should draw itself.
defects.detail: summoning jutsu: drops quickly to one knee and slams his right palm flat on the ground in front of him, holds the palm pressed to the ground while staring straight ahead to the right, then pushes off and stands back up into the fighting stance. defects.problem: Kakashi disappears completely for 3 of 8 frames. Frames 1-2 are a large white/grey striped disc the size of the character, and frame 3 is almost empty with only a few navy streaks. The player sees him turn into a white ball, not an air dodge.

defects.problem: Big bright blue energy arcs run from the top of the frame to his legs, wrap around the extended fist and touch the right edge. That is far bigger than a small effect.

defects.problem: A stray dark-red object (the clothing of an invented opponent) sits where his hands close, and the right edge of the frame cuts it off. It is largest in frames 1-2, which include impact frame 1, and slivers with a black outline remain in frames 0 and 3.
defects.detail: red (erase the dark-red cloth and its black outline pixels at the right edge, and keep his hands and the red swirl on his shoulder)

defects.problem: The impact frames are wrong. In frame 0 he still lies flat on his back, so the hitbox comes out with no blow. The kick in front is frame 1, and the sweep that hits both in front and behind (split legs) is frame 3.
His kicking foot is drawn as a big solid black blob, about the size of his torso, which flashes on screen between the two kicks.
defects.detail: Replace frame 2 with frame 1.

defects.problem: There is no throw motion. Frames 0-3 are the same static hold pose with the arms out, then he simply drops back into his stance. There is no heave and no push, so the opponent flies away while Kakashi does nothing.
defects.detail: forward throw: from holding at arm's length with both hands, pulls both hands back to his chest while leaning back, then steps forward and shoves both open palms hard straight ahead at full arm extension, body leaning far forward, then returns to the fighting stance. Only Kakashi is drawn: the opponent is invisible, there is no other person in the frame.

defects.problem: He does not look held. All 4 frames show his normal relaxed fighting stance with his fists up, and only one foot lifts a little. There is no struggling and no pull at the collar, so it reads as idling while he is being grabbed.
defects.detail: held up by the collar from in front of him: chest pulled forward, head tilted back in pain, both hands clutching at the collar at his throat, legs kicking and squirming, body wriggling, a seamless loop. Only Kakashi is drawn: the opponent is invisible, there is no other person in the frame.

defects.problem: This is a standing low kick, not a crouching sweep. His torso stays fully upright at standing height for the whole clip (frames 0-1 even show a long back-leg step), so coming out of a crouch he visibly pops up to full height for a down tilt.
defects.detail: crouching leg sweep: stays squatted very low the whole time, hips near his heels and back bent forward, one hand touching the ground for support, swings the front leg out straight and sweeps it along the floor in front of him, then rises back into the fighting stance. defects.problem: The impact frame 2 is covered by a huge white and orange burst that hides the kicking leg completely, so the frame the game holds while the hitbox is out shows an explosion and no kick. Frame 3 still has large orange streaks fanning across the frame over the leg. Frame 5 shows the same kick at belly height with no effect.

It is red and white, the same colours as the shoulder emblem and the hair, so it cannot be erased by colour.
defects.detail: Frame 0 is replaced by frame 1, which has the same recoil pose with the head snapped back and only a few tiny red specks.

defects.problem: It looks the same as the jump/fall pose: knees tucked and arms spread out for balance in every frame. Nothing shows he is exhausted, and the arms are not limp above his head. Players cannot tell the helpless state, when he cannot act, apart from a normal fall.
defects.detail: falls helplessly, exhausted: both arms hang limp straight up above his head, the head droops back, the legs hang loose and straight below with the toes pointing down, the body slowly tilts back and forth, a seamless loop. Only Kakashi is drawn

defects.problem: A huge light-blue and white swirl fills the whole box in frames 5-8 and runs off its edges in frames 6-8. Faint white rings remain in frames 9-10. defects.detail: neutral aerial in mid-air: pulls the knees tight to the chest with the arms wrapped around the shins and does one fast forward somersault, then snaps both legs and both arms out wide in a star-shaped kick, holds it for a moment, then tucks back into the same tucked pose, the same outfit and colours the whole time.
